wrangler secret put GC_API_KEY on demo-gc-pg (richcanvas) — the key lives on the Worker, never in the agent or its playbook. Until it is set the MCP fails closed with `{error}`, never a table of zeros.
notes: CHARTERING LEAVES THREE THINGS UNDONE, and `charter-service.mts` now does two of them: the Home's `related-orgs` link (without it the agent is absent from its steward's pulldown) and the vault key bind (without it every record at the agent is `vault_key_unauthorized`, its archetype assignment and playbook included). The third — buying the name on a priced root — is `buy-name.mts`.

`service.create` is idempotent on the agent: the address derives from (custodian, parent, label). `--relink` re-runs it only to recover the stewardship wire, which lives in the act's result and nowhere else.
Ten SHQ, once: the treasury went 988 → 978. `registry.owner(node)` is what says a name is bought — never `resolveName`, which reads the `addr` record an unpresented name does not have.
